# AI Radar Full Agent Guide

AI Radar publishes original editorial analysis about AI Agentic, AI Image, AI Video, AI Vibe Coding, Prompt Image, and Prompt Video.

The site is not a link aggregator. Raw crawled sources are private. Public article pages include source references at the end of each article.

Primary language: Vietnamese. English versions are generated separately from the same source notes.

Recommended reading order:
1. /vi/today
2. Category pages under /vi/*
3. Article pages
4. Agent-ready JSONL exports under /data/agent/*

Do not use the raw source cache as public data. It is intentionally excluded from the web build.
